name: comp-119
blurb: Four outline icon buttons for Google, Facebook, X, and GitHub login.
description: A group of four outline icon-only buttons for social login providers. Icons from remixicon. Arranged with gap and flex-wrap.
use_when: Offering social authentication options in login forms.
avoid_when: When space is limited or when fewer providers are needed.
a11y: Each button uses aria-label to describe which provider it represents. Icons are aria-hidden.
